Abstract:

The mining and natural resource sector serves as a primary pillar of national industrial growth, raw material security, and infrastructure development. Understanding this domain requires not only technical mastery in extraction and exploration, but also a thorough grounding in the legal and economic governance structures that dictate resource allocation. This session will offer an in-depth exploration into how these regulatory mechanisms operate in practice, bridging the gap between classroom theory and real-world industrial compliance. Our expert speaker will guide participants through the technical parameters and financial eligibility criteria required for securing Mining Leases and Composite Licences, illustrating how modern engineering projects interact with state and central regulatory authorities. Furthermore, the discussion will highlight the social and environmental dimensions of modern mineral policy, including the role of District Mineral Foundations in ensuring local community development and promoting sustainable mining methodologies.
